item_name: Rothco Black Soft Shell Uniform Jacket
item_short_desc: Stay prepared for all-weather conditions with Rothco’s Black Soft Shell Uniform Jacket. Designed with a 3-layer waterproof construction, this soft shell jacket keeps you warm and dry by deflecting wind, wicking away moisture, and retaining your body heat. The soft fleece lining provides additional comfort, while underarm ventilation zippers allow for customizable airflow to prevent overheating.
description: Stay prepared for all-weather conditions with Rothco’s Black Soft Shell Uniform Jacket. Designed with a 3-layer waterproof construction, this soft shell jacket keeps you warm and dry by deflecting wind, wicking away moisture, and retaining your body heat. The soft fleece lining provides additional comfort, while underarm ventilation zippers allow for customizable airflow to prevent overheating. Featuring a fleece-lined collar, zippered front closure, and adjustable drawstring waist with elastic wrist cuffs, this uniform jacket offers a secure and comfortable fit. 2 zippered front slash pockets give you convenient storage for your gear. Whether you're on the go or in harsh conditions, this durable and lightweight jacket is perfect for keeping you protected from the elements.
